EC2: Parasitic worm infection [AND] e.g. schistosomiasis [OR], and hook worm by stool analysis.
EC3: Any cases giving clinical symptoms of gastritis e.g. nausea [OR], vomiting [OR], dull aching pain [OR] or soreness in the epigastrium.
EC4: Cases with history of gastric ulcer [AND] diagnosed by upper endoscopy.
